name: South Africa (1928–1994)

flag.description: Three equal horizontal stripes of orange, white and blue, with three small flags in the center of the white stripe: the Union Jack, the flag of the Orange Free State and the flag of the South African Republic (Transvaal).
flag.symbolism: The orange, white and blue came from the Dutch Prince's Flag of the early settlers, and the three small flags stood for Britain and the two former Boer republics.

hook: The flag of the Union and of apartheid-era South Africa is orange-white-blue with three tiny flags in the middle; the Netherlands has red on top and no flags.
trivia: Until 1957 the Union Jack was also an official national flag, flown alongside this one.
It was replaced on 27 April 1994, the day of South Africa's first elections open to all races.
